name: hiring-by-role
description: Role-specific hiring guides for B2B SaaS — interview questions, evaluation criteria, scorecards, and assessment methods for engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, product, and design roles. Based on best practices from Betts Recruiting, Bridge Group, SaaStr, YC, and Google re:Work. Use when building an interview process for a specific role or evaluating candidates systematically. Triggers on: "interview questions for [role]", "how to hire [role]", "scorecard for [role]", "evaluate [role] candidates".
